Credits/extras require institutional equity funding, even though general program participation is broader.

signals.catch: High execution burden in roughly two days; this is not a passive credit capture.
signals.changed: The WebMCP Challenge submission deadline is September 3, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. PDT.
signals.fit: US independent builders are eligible subject to rules. A working live WebMCP app, public open-source repo, and sub-three-minute public demo video are required.

signals.immediate_exploit: Only test if a deployable one-surface concept and demo can be completed without displacing the revenue work already in flight.

result_summary: First receipt-bearing LEVERAGE SEEKER run. Two bounded TEST surfaces were confirmed (Tencent Hy4 temporary free application access; OpenCode Zen temporary zero-priced model surface). WebMCP is a closing-window TEST, not an automatic priority override. The Devin $65K headline was corrected to $15K free plus a conditional $50K matching grant. The claim of a verified unrestricted free GLM 5.2 hosted API was rejected.
